limits: Two English songs, two Spanish songs, six Japanese utterances; not catalogue-wide evidence.
PJS is one human singer, clean a cappella; Japanese original-script variants count as CER errors.
Jam-ALT line timing only; no Japanese lexical word timing reference.
Elapsed times are observed accuracy-run costs, not controlled speed comparisons.
Quantized inference and CPU recovery were tested on 24 GB hardware, not on an 8 GB Mac.
